title: Parameter file of the Tier-4 stage-1 Skill (SYNTHETIC -- FICTIONAL STUDY)
description: Exactly two parameters. Every path is a string; a relative path resolves against the directory that holds the parameter file. The checker root and the Ruby interpreter are not parameters: they are the environment, supplied at invocation.

subject_generation.description: Parameter 1: how the subjects were made. Identified by hash and read against the bundle after the table is written; never passed to the harness or the table script.

generator_dir.description: Directory of the subject generator (in the source repository: selfapp/generator). Hashed as a tree; never run.

variant_spec.description: The planted-fault variant specification (in the source repository: selfapp/variants_v1.json). Must be JSON with base.id, base.tree_sha256 and variants[].id.

make_variants.description: The script that applies the spec (in the source repository: scripts/selfapp/make_variants.rb). Only its MakeVariants.plan is called, in a separate process; it writes nothing.

input_bundle.description: Parameter 2: the frozen input bundle, a directory holding inputs_manifest.json and exactly the files it names. Read only.
